name: account
description: Operations for Amazon Web Services Account Management

subcommands.name: accept-primary-email-update
subcommands.description: Accepts the request that originated from StartPrimaryEmailUpdate to update the primary email address (also known as the root user email address) for the specified account.

subcommands.name: delete-alternate-contact
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified alternate contact from an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: disable-region
subcommands.description: Disables (opts-out) a particular Region for an account.

subcommands.name: enable-region
subcommands.description: Enables (opts-in) a particular Region for an account.

subcommands.name: get-account-information
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified account including its account name, account ID, account creation date and time, and account state.

subcommands.name: get-alternate-contact
subcommands.description: Retrieves the specified alternate contact attached to an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-contact-information
subcommands.description: Retrieves the primary contact information of an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-gov-cloud-account-information
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the GovCloud account linked to the specified standard account (if it exists) including the GovCloud account ID and state.

subcommands.name: get-primary-email
subcommands.description: Retrieves the primary email address for the specified account.

subcommands.name: get-primary-email-update-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves the status of the most recent primary email update for the specified account.

subcommands.name: get-region-opt-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves the opt-in status of a particular Region.

subcommands.name: list-regions
subcommands.description: Lists all the Regions for a given account and their respective opt-in statuses.

subcommands.name: put-account-name
subcommands.description: Updates the account name of the specified account.

subcommands.name: put-alternate-contact
subcommands.description: Modifies the specified alternate contact attached to an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: put-contact-information
subcommands.description: Updates the primary contact information of an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: start-primary-email-update
subcommands.description: Starts the process to update the primary email address for the specified account.
